==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A barbarian sorcerer teleported the Reality Warping Stone into his grasp. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Barbarian Sorcerer resembles a muscular barbarian in brown furs, with tall pointed elf ears, a round pink nose, a bushy black beard, and a bushy black afro.) (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.)
He sacrificed his own powers in an attempt to neutralize the stone so that no one could use it to become a god. (After he loses his powers, the Barbarian Sorcerer's arms freeze into an icy blue color.)
I protected the Reality Warping Stone with an aura of Lucid Light, making the barbarian's sacrifice worthless. (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
